scope_note: Three separately controlled whitespace operations were tested.
limitation: The aggregate spans distinct conditions and is not a pooled recovery estimand.
No controlled insertion or reflow of visual line wraps was tested.

scope_note: Leading and trailing whitespace removal per message was tested.
limitation: Whitespace addition was not separately tested.
Other normalization forms were not separately tested.

scope_note: Straight quotes were deterministically converted to directional smart quotes.
limitation: The reverse direction and locale-specific quotation systems were not separately tested.

scope_note: No isolated punctuation-edit condition exists in the frozen design.
limitation: Character substitution targeted alphanumeric characters and cannot establish punctuation robustness.

scope_note: No arbitrary prefix or suffix condition exists in the frozen design.
limitation: Markdown blockquote markup is not a general prefix/suffix test.

scope_note: A Markdown-style blockquote copy/paste transformation was tested.
limitation: Email-client quoting, headers, nesting, and client-specific reflow were not tested.

scope_note: No controlled case transformation exists in the frozen design.
limitation: No recovery estimate is available for case conversion.

scope_note: A deterministic broad paraphrase condition could alter sentence structure.
limitation: Sentence-boundary edits were not isolated from wording and semantic-rewrite changes.

scope_note: A fixed copy/paste pipeline normalized line endings, trimmed trailing space, and prefixed blockquote markup.
limitation: This is one deterministic pipeline, not a survey of applications or operating systems.
